## What this adds

Confidence tooling for launch: unit tests, starter e2e tests, social preview metadata, and optional Sentry.

## Highlights

- Vitest for lead score, booking transitions, and API response helpers
- Playwright specs for homepage and form pages
- Open Graph metadata on the root layout
- Sentry only when `SENTRY_DSN` is set

## How to test

Run `npm run test` and `npm run build`. Run `npm run test:e2e` with the dev server up.

## Note

Merged into `Dev` last among the feature sprints (#13–#17).
